question:
You will be shown several images captured during a robotic manipulation task.
Each image comes with a description of the camera position from which it was taken.
Please use this information to help answer the following question.


Image 1 (ego_right): This image represents the right arm camera's perspective during the manipulation task.


Image 2 (ego_left): The left wrist camera captures this egocentric view of the robotic operation.


Image 3 (fix_center): This image was taken from a fixed camera at the center, facing the manipulation scene.


Multiple camera views of a robotic operation are presented here.
While most images are temporally consistent, one frame was taken at a different moment.
Observe the spatial relationships, environmental conditions, and robot state variations.
Identify the image number that shows temporal inconsistency.
